---
name: Feature Request
description: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] <short description>"
labels: ['enhancement', 'triage']
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Example: "I'm unable to run Qwen3-8B on my RTX 3060 12GB because..."

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative approaches or tools you've tried (e.g., `llama.cpp`, `text-generation-webui`).

**Additional context**
- GPU model and VRAM.
- NInfer version / commit.
- Any relevant use‑case (e.g., speculative decoding, vision, different KV dtype).
